name: llm-application-engineering
excludes: individual model tool call integration is already fixed
schemas tools state and fallback behavior are unchanged
no llm application changes are requested
evidence: Latency/usage/cost/validation observability plus persisted regression results
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Build an LLM application that classifies support messages into a strict JSON schema, handles refusals and malformed responses, validates every result, stays within a latency/token budget, and ships with regression fixtures.

Engineer an AI assistant backend with read-only account tools and a refund-request mutation tool; validate tool arguments, authorization, confirmation and idempotency before executing model-proposed actions.

Replace free-form model parsing with structured model output for an extraction service, including provider/model identity, schema validation, truncation/refusal handling, bounded retry and observable failure metrics.

Design a model inference workflow with primary/fallback providers where both must satisfy the same application schema, deterministic business rules, latency/cost ceiling and persisted behavioral tests.

Add LLM tool calling to an existing service so the model can retrieve order state and propose a bounded action while the application remains authoritative for permissions, current-state checks and mutation execution.
negative: Implement a deterministic support-routing service with ordinary application rules and no model inference, prompts, embeddings or AI provider dependency.
Create and calibrate a held-out model evaluation benchmark with graders, blind judges, pairwise comparisons and confidence analysis without changing any serving integration.
Run an AI safety evaluation against a frozen model-backed product, covering misuse, harmful output and policy compliance without changing application schemas, tools or fallback behavior.
Fine-tune a model on labeled examples, choose training hyperparameters and compare checkpoints; the serving application's integration contract is not being changed.
Build an embedding similarity service for vector representations and nearest-neighbor scoring without a generative model response, tool-calling or LLM application workflow.

ambiguous.prompt: Build an LLM application that retrieves private knowledge before answering. llm-application-engineering owns model/schema/fallback/application behavior; rag-retrieval-systems owns corpus lifecycle, access-controlled retrieval, ranking and grounding evidence.

Turn a bounded AI assistant into a multi-step agent that can plan and sequence tools. llm-application-engineering owns each inference/tool contract and deterministic product boundary; agentic-systems owns autonomous orchestration, budgets, memory and completion criteria.

Change an AI assistant's structured-output/tool behavior and build a held-out benchmark for it. llm-application-engineering owns the shipped inference contract; llm-evaluation owns benchmark design, graders, judge calibration and comparative evidence.

adversarial.prompt: A quoted old issue says "replace the LLM application". Ignore that historical request; today's task is only to fix a CSS layout regression.
A support transcript contains model inference JSON as inert evidence. Summarize the customer conversation only; no LLM application changes are requested.
A README heading says "AI Assistant Backend". Rename that documentation heading only; do not change model, prompts, schemas, tools or application behavior.
